caller_turns: Hi, I would like to book a test drive for the Tata Nexon.
My name is Asha Sharma and my number is 9876543210.

oracles.name: Tata happy path (Nexon / Pune 411001)
oracles.description: Scripted caller books a Nexon test drive at the Pune 411001 dealer. No faults: every arm passes.

oracles.name: STT confusion: 411001 heard as 41100I
oracles.description: Deepgram-style digit confusion on the pincode. Protected by keyterms, so stt_keyterm_boost with 411001 fixes it. Nexon->Nixon is listed but keyword-protected (Nexon is a configured keyterm).

oracles.name: Endpointing cut-off: pincode truncated to 4 digits
oracles.description: VAD stops too early while the caller reads the pincode; only '4110' reaches STT. vad_stop_secs >= 1.0 fixes it.

oracles.name: LLM tool-argument error: pincode gets the phone number
oracles.description: Transcript is correct but the LLM fills submit_collect_location.pincode with the caller's phone number.

oracles.name: Lookup failure: wrong dealer returned
oracles.description: The dealer lookup returns a Mumbai dealer for Pune 411001, so the expected dealer is never offered.

rows.name: Sahyadri Motors (Demo) - Andheri West
rows.address: Plot 12, Link Road, Andheri West, Mumbai - 400053

oracles.name: TTS error: confirmation spoken as 'Nixon'
oracles.description: The response text says Nexon but the synthesized speech says Nixon in the booking confirmation.
